adopted_wording: 4-bit Q4_0 weights raise the closer-slip probability at the decision point ~4x vs bf16, for plain PTQ and for Google's QAT in any export.
QAT recovers little (greedy slips ~45% fewer than PTQ; expected-probability difference n.s.).
The -ct export adds a small, non-attributable +1.4 pp.
Google's "unquantized" QAT release already behaves quantized (61% of weights on the Q4_0 grid; matrices shrunk).
retired_wording: QAT training, not quantization (12:33-13:22 UTC interim; superseded by arm 5)

models.qat_fakeQ4_0: QAT-unquantized fake-quantized to the llama.cpp Q4_0 grid
models.bf16_fakeQ4_0: bf16 original fake-quantized to the same Q4_0 grid (plain PTQ control)

headline.method: teacher forcing in generation mode on identical token ids: prompt = logged context (June-5 main-track template) + logged response tokens up to the decision point; max_tokens=1, logprobs=20; no prompt_logprobs

decision_point_population_qat_vs_bf16.note: P(look-alike) at the logged sampling temperature at the end-of-new_string decision point of clean-history edit calls; valid and slip states re-weighted to their population frequencies (Gemma-only logs). For QAT this should reproduce the observed pool slip rate (validation of the teacher-forcing probe).

qat_duplicate_rows_in_used_keys.rule: first file in sorted order wins (r31b_heldout before r31b_old_*)

replay_contagion_injection.estimands: ITT = P(next call is a malformed edit_file) over all contexts (primary); conditional = P(malformed | both models emit edit_file) (secondary). Clusters = attempts (contexts_meta task): Wilson CIs for single rates, attempt-cluster bootstrap for differences and ratios.

For QAT this should reproduce the observed pool slip rate (validation of the teacher-forcing probe).

logged_margin_predicts_replay_slip_qat.note: score = log P(look-alike) - log P(<|"|>) at the logged VALID call's new_string closer (June-5 template, same model as the replay); replay = order-replay natural arm on the same context (July template, fresh sample).

slip_onset.caveat: top-20 truncated sampler; states limited to prompts <=12.9k tokens (F length filter); QAT-generated prefix held fixed

slip_post.caveat: top-20 truncated sampler; states limited to prompts <=12.9k tokens (F length filter); QAT-generated prefix held fixed
